parsed_entries.requirement: An information system programmed by or on behalf of the originator must operate automatically to ensure proper attribution, acknowledgment, and despatch of electronic records.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the information system operates automatically as per the clause.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all electronic records despatched by the originator.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause mandates the use of an automated system for handling electronic records.

parsed_entries.requirement: The despatch of an electronic record occurs when it enters a computer resource outside the control of the originator, unless otherwise agreed upon.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the despatch timing is defined as the entry into a computer resource outside the originator's control.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all electronic records despatched by the originator.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause defines the timing of despatch for electronic records.

parsed_entries.requirement: Receipt of an electronic record occurs when it enters the designated computer resource, or when it is retrieved by the addressee if sent to a non-designated resource.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the receipt timing is defined based on entry into the designated resource or retrieval by the addressee.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all electronic records sent to an addressee.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause defines the timing of receipt for electronic records.

parsed_entries.requirement: If no designated computer resource is specified, receipt occurs when the electronic record enters the addressee's computer resource.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the receipt timing is defined as the entry into the addressee's computer resource when no designated resource is specified.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all electronic records sent to an addressee without a designated resource.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause defines the timing of receipt for electronic records when no designated resource is specified.

parsed_entries.requirement: The signature creation data must be under the exclusive control of the signatory at the time of affixing the signature.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the signature creation data is under the exclusive control of the signatory at the time of signing.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all electronic signatures used in electronic records.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause mandates exclusive control of signature creation data by the signatory.

parsed_entries.requirement: Certifying Authorities must specify the conditions under which they conduct their business.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Certifying Authorities have specified the conditions for conducting their business.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause requires Certifying Authorities to specify the conditions for their operations.
